structured_output.mechanisms: Time is steps times per-step cost, which grows with the squared conv widths (stage 1 most per channel) and sub-linearly with batch size. Low-resolution phases cut time by a fraction of the steps they cover. Accuracy rises with epochs (diminishing returns) and width, and falls with cutout, random flip, and low-res phases. Light translate and label smoothing of about 0.1 help.
